decision.summary: A multi-axis coherent offset begins ~487: U drops sharply (~10 MAD), N and E rise modestly (~4 and ~2 MAD). The offset persists through 492 (end of screened region), but no clear opposing return is observed within allowed context [450,527]; post-492 U stays low, N/E fluctuate without rejoining pre-event trend. Thus, temporary nature cannot be confirmed—status uncertain.

intervals.observation: U shows a sharp multi-sample drop (~10 MAD) starting ~487, sustained through 492; N and E show smaller upward steps (~4 and ~2 MAD) beginning ~488–489 and persisting through 492. Return is not observed within allowed context (ends at 527), and post-492 U remains offset without clear reversal; N/E show minor fluctuations but no definitive return to pre-event levels. Onset and interior are coherent across axes; return ambiguous.
